mapper.select: SELECT agent_id, wechat_user_id, openviking_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM user_agent_identities ORDER BY created_at ASC, agent_id ASC
SELECT agent_id, wechat_user_id, openviking_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM user_agent_identities WHERE wechat_user_id = #{wechatUserId} LIMIT 1
SELECT agent_id, wechat_user_id, openviking_user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM user_agent_identities WHERE wechat_user_id = #{wechatUserId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agent_identities (agent_id, wechat_user_id, openviking_user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{wechatUserId}, #{openvikingUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
